asset.name: Calendar
asset.description: The reusable calendar surface supporting single, multiple, range, week, and month selection with localization, constraints, keyboard navigation, and virtualized month rendering.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Composite widgets expose a single tab stop with arrow-key movement.
First day of week, month naming, and calendar system are locale-specific.
Horizontal date movement reverses in right-to-left reading order.
